youtube.title: Where Do Animals Live? with Quackers! (SPLASH!) | Nerdy Noodles
youtube.description:
🏡 SPLASH! Quackers the duck splashed so big that all the animal friends ran home! Where did they go?

Visit each animal in its real home with Quackers: the pig and the sheep on the farm, the frog in the pond, the fish in the ocean, the bird in the sky and the owl in the forest, and hear the REAL sound each animal makes. Then sing the animal homes song, and stay till the end, because one more friend lives somewhere very close to you! 🐾

Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten kids (ages 2-6).

✨ In this video, kids will:
✔️ Learn where animals live: farm, pond, ocean, sky and forest
✔️ Learn 6 animal names: pig, frog, fish, bird, owl and sheep
✔️ Hear the real sounds animals make
✔️ Sing an animal homes song with Quackers!
